'''Gesen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Inquisitor]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the Sith [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], he could be found inside the [[Tomb of Ajunta Pall]]. He was studying a dead K'lor'slug while helping guard the one of the entrances. He helped aspiring Sith Inquisitors train in the arts of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].
